jobs.name: family-elite.png
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Input image: proposal-gold.png is an identity and visual-rendering reference only; retain Max's original face, proportions and finish, but create the specified new outfit and pose.
Asset type: standalone Max mascot family wardrobe base for an existing luxury website. One single full-length character, premium polished 3D illustration matching the reference.
Character lock: Max's ORIGINAL recognizable mature face, swept silver hair, black rectangular spectacles, neatly shaped white beard, genial SMALL smile, same warm skin and facial structure as the reference. Tall elegant slim body with visibly long legs. Do not make younger, bulkier, squat or cartoon-chibi.
Canvas/composition: exactly 1024x1536 portrait. Entire head, hair, hands, coat hems and shoes visible with comfortable navy space beyond every extremity, including above hair and below shoes. Centre the complete silhouette. Clean flat solid midnight navy #0B1629 backdrop, no alpha/transparency, no checkerboard, no floor scene or scenery.
Critical chest requirement: a SMALL embroidered serif "NB" on Max's LEFT chest, which is on the VIEWER-RIGHT. The fabric immediately BELOW this NB must be completely EMPTY, clean, uninterrupted garment cloth. This is a base image: render NO chest shield, NO chest gemstone, NO chest badge, NO chest patch, NO placeholder mounting shape, NO medallion and NO outline or decorative motif below NB. Leave enough simple cloth below NB for a future external overlay. Do not copy a shield from any input.
Constraints: no cane, no crown, no extra props, no title, no page text, no additional characters, no crop.
Wardrobe: coordinated deep navy tailored long coat, restrained bronze and violet embroidered edging; plum patterned waistcoat; ivory cravat; dark navy tailored trousers with subtle bronze side piping; polished black loafers. Keep bronze-violet edgework restrained and elegant, not ornate all-over ornament. Small NB in bronze on viewer-right chest.
Pose: helpful explanatory gesture. One palm tilted open at waist height; the other hand gently gestures toward the viewer-right. A natural balanced stance, long legs fully shown. Neither hand obscures the NB or the clean empty cloth under it.
Make this one shared, coherent Elite family wardrobe, no rank-specific shield.

Fill that little area with ordinary uninterrupted plain deep-navy fabric, matching the adjacent lapel. The blank area should extend from just under NB at image y=20.2% down to y=24%, centered x=54.1%, roughly x=52.0% to 56.3%. It must be clean fabric for a later external shield overlay, with NO replacement ornament, outline, patch, badge, shield, jewel or mounting shape. Preserve the narrow bronze lapel edge piping.
Keep absolutely everything else visually unchanged: NB itself, Max's exact face, hair, glasses, beard, smile and mature identity; all framing and pose; full tall silhouette and long legs; pointing/open hands; coat, other embroidery, plum patterned waistcoat, ivory cravat, dark navy trousers and bronze piping, black loafers; lighting, midnight navy background and exact 1024x1536 canvas. Do not recrop or shift the character. ONLY clear the little ornamental flourish underneath NB.
